title: People’s Perceptions Toward Bias and Related Concepts in Large Language Models: A Systematic Review

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review (PRISMA) and thematic analysis of empirical studies using human evaluators to assess individual and social biases, such as stereotypes, mental health stigmas, and thinking traps in LLM outputs.

Synthesis of empirical studies where human evaluators assessed machine-generated texts (e.g., rewritten news on gender-based violence) for the presence and reinforcement of gender stereotypes and biases.
Synthesis of human evaluation studies exploring variations in user perceptions, agreements, and expectations of LLMs across different countries and cultural norms.

Systematic review of human evaluation studies assessing user perceptions of inaccurate, unfair, toxic, or preference-biased LLM outputs stemming from imbalanced training data and algorithmic constraints.
